title: Atomic hotfix coordination for customer-impacting canary regressions
creator: Asha Patel
description: Summary: A subset of recent model rollouts caused semantic regressions in hosted and Dedicated customers during canary windows. This ticket defines an "atomic hotfix" coordination workflow that minimizes blast radius across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments, ensures customers are notified promptly, and captures telemetry for fast RCA. Goals: 1) Rapid creation and vetting of a fix branch that can be applied to hosted model variants and pushed as a controlled pin for Dedicated/Private; 2) A clear cross-team owner list and playbook for coordinating canary pause, pinning, rollback, and customer communication; 3) Automated telemetry checks and smoke-tests to validate the hotfix before broad rollout; 4) Post-incident postmortem and improvement backlog items. Scope: model rollout regressions (semantic quality), failures detected in canaries or small-customer cohorts, cross-env coordination (Hosted API, Redwood Dedicated clusters, customer Private deployments). Not in scope: infra-only GPU hardware failures or unrelated SLO degradations.
comments: 2025-02-20 — Asha Patel: Initial report from monitoring: chat_generation_accuracy_alert triggered by synthetic evals after model v3.4 rollout to canary cohort (5% of traffic). Notified two affected customers (acme-corp, finance-app) with templated incident update. Dedicated clusters held (no autoscale) pending pinned rollout plan.

Smoke-tests: passed end-to-end generation, token-latency within SLO, but edge-case tokenization mismatch observed in private on-prem environment — tracking with ENG-41241.
